claims.text: The cancellation fee is chargeable only if the driver held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force, and for this AIRPORT pick-up that period is 480 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec is 480, matching fee_schedule minimum_dwell_sec for AIRPORT). POL-NS-01(c) measures that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's arrival tap. The driver's own trace shows one continuous qualifying in-geofence run of 255 seconds, from 23:42:21 to 23:46:36 - some 225 seconds short of the minimum, at an arrival radius of 150 m for AIRPORT. Limb (c) is not satisfied and the fee is not chargeable. I disclose that EV-GPS-00210 is impaired - CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD, weight 0.25 - and the point survives the discount because the shortfall is separately corroborated by the trip record below.

Where the effective in-geofence dwell falls short of the free waiting period in force, POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation fee in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages, and it pays the driver nothing. The derived arrival block puts the accumulated in-geofence dwell at 0.0 seconds across 0 runs with a shortfall of 480.0 seconds, and the single qualifying run the trace does show is 255 seconds. The whole SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line therefore falls and no driver compensation is payable. EV-GPS-00210 is impaired as disclosed above (weight 0.25); EV-FARE-00210 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and fixes the amount at SGD 6.00.

Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is independently unsatisfied. The trip record's 'arrived' event is stamped 23:42:10, and limb (b) requires the trace to place the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius at or before that timestamp. The trace's only qualifying in-geofence fixes are the five that make up the run beginning 23:42:21 - qualifying_fix_count is 5 and longest_qualifying_run.fix_count is 5 - so no qualifying fix exists at or before the arrival event, and the four earlier fixes (23:34:50, 23:37:45, 23:38:23, 23:39:15) do not qualify against the arrival-radius test at all. POL-NS-02 therefore does not place the driver at the pin when the marker was pressed.

The platform's own trip record corroborates the shortfall on its own arithmetic, so this point does not depend on the trace. arrived_at is 23:42:10 and cancelled_at is 23:49:05, and the record reports wait_time_min of 6.9 - roughly 414 seconds. Even read in the manner most favourable to the driver, the platform's own record shows the wait falling about 66 seconds short of the 480 second AIRPORT minimum. I disclose that EV-TRIP-00210 is impaired (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, weight 0.4, because its arrival and implied wait cannot be reconciled with the trace); the point survives the discount because the two records disagree about the size of the shortfall but not about its existence.

The driver's arrival tap cannot start the waiting clock, and the record itself shows why. trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so POL-NS-12's platform-confirmed route does not apply and arrival must be proved on the exported trace. That trace is impaired under POL-NS-08(a): its device stamps run 228 seconds ahead of the server, and its last fix is 23:46:36 against a recorded termination of 23:49:05 - a 149 second disagreement on termination alone. Neither the arrived event nor the termination can be safely matched to a fix, so POL-NS-05 cannot be run to recompute the clock either, and the dwell must run from the trace's own first qualifying in-geofence fix at 23:42:21.

The trace is impaired for policy purposes, not merely at schema level: five fixes fall inside the wait the record itself asserts (23:42:21, 23:43:13, 23:44:05, 23:45:44, 23:46:36 against a 23:42:10 to 23:49:05 window), which is fewer than the six POL-NS-08(b) requires, and a 186 second sampling gap sits across the moment of geofence entry. Under POL-GEN-02(2) any finding that rests on this artifact is capped at its weight_multiplier of 0.25, below the 0.70 platform floor, and POL-NS-08 closes by capping a ruling whose only evidence for the deciding fact is impaired and routing the case to review. On this evidence the driver cannot carry limb (c) and the SGD 6.00 fee cannot be collected; at the very least it is held. I name the issue codes again: CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD.

EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING: no traffic advisory covers the Changi T1 arrival kerb in this window, and its absence is itself citable. That matters, because POL-NS-06(i) is the only route by which a driver may accumulate separate in-geofence intervals toward the minimum, and it requires a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. With the artifact missing, limb (i) is unavailable - the derived block records it unavailable for a missing traffic_advisory, with run_count 0 and 0.0 seconds accumulated - so there is no lawful reason for the driver to have held position off the pin and no ground to discount the shortfall.

The chat export is gapped exactly across the handover. Its own sequence runs from MSG-00210-001 to MSG-00210-004, and the trip record records chat_message_count 4, but the export carries only 2 messages - so messages 002 and 003 are missing somewhere in the 23:42 to 23:49 window between the arrival notification and the rider's protest. POL-NS-08(c) makes that a policy-level impairment, and it bears directly on POL-NS-04(a), which asks what the rider sent during the waiting window: the export cannot show what was said at the moment the driver says he was waiting at Door 6, so no adverse reading of the rider's coordination can be taken from it. EV-CHAT-00210 is impaired (TRUNCATED_LOG, weight 0.6) and I disclose it.

The trace carries no rider track at all (rider_presence.available is false), so the presence test in POL-NS-04(c) cannot be run. POL-NS-11 makes that UNDECIDABLE rather than failed: it is neither satisfied nor failed, POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on it, and the judge must say the test could not be run rather than inferring the rider was elsewhere. Nothing in this record affirmatively places the rider away from Door 6; the only rider message surviving in the export, sent at 23:49:40, is 'why cancel?? i was at door 6'. EV-GPS-00210 is impaired at weight 0.25 and EV-CHAT-00210 at 0.6 (TRUNCATED_LOG), as disclosed above.

claims.text: The contested $6.00 is exactly the cancellation fee in force for an AIRPORT-zone no-show on this trip, and it reconciles with the fare breakdown's own derived money block: a zone-class fee of $6.00 against a charged cancellation line of $6.00, difference $0.00. There is therefore no fare integrity defect and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged on the amount. The fare breakdown is COMPLETE at weight 1.0; the trip record is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, which touches its arrival and dwell fields, not the charge amount.

The trip record contains a driver 'arrived' event at 23:42:10 and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 23:49:05 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which satisfies POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d). The trip record is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT: those two fields are the platform's own telemetry, nothing else in the bundle contradicts the reason code, and the rider's own filing does not assert that he boarded or that the driver chose any other reason code.

The driver's trace contains 5 consecutive qualifying in-geofence fixes, more than the 3 consecutive in-radius fixes POL-NS-02 requires, with a minimum measured distance of 96.0 m from the pickup pin, inside the 150 m arrival radius that applies to the AIRPORT zone class. The trace is IMPAIRED at weight 0.25 with issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD; the clock defect shifts timestamps rather than positions, so the in-radius fix count is untouched by the discount and POL-NS-02's proximity test is met.

The record's own admissibility finding is that the driver device clock runs a known 228 s ahead of the server clock. Correcting the first qualifying in-geofence fix (device 23:42:21) by that known offset puts the driver inside the geofence at 23:38:33 server time, before the 23:42:10 arrived event, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) is met; and the continuous dwell from that fix to the 23:49:05 cancellation is 632 s, above the 480 s free waiting period in force for this AIRPORT trip, so limb (c) is met also. Read at face value the same span is only 404 s, which is why the correction matters - and the 186 s gap running from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 sits exactly across geofence entry, so the export cannot be read at face value against the platform's own arrival event. The trace is IMPAIRED at weight 0.25 with issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD, and the trip record is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 with CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

POL-NS-03 is not the governing clause. It applies only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, and it always ends in a full refund of the fee. Here the qualifying fixes lie inside the 150 m AIRPORT radius, the closest at 96.0 m, so the wrong-entrance regime is not engaged and does not displace the fee.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. Limb (a) requires a rider message that is locating or coordinating and sent during the waiting window; the only rider message surviving in the log is sent at 23:49:40, thirty-five seconds after the driver's 23:49:05 cancellation, and the only in-window message is the SYSTEM notice 'Your driver has arrived' at 23:42:11, which is not the rider's own. Limb (c) cannot be run at all, because the trace carries no rider_track, so under POL-NS-11 it is undecidable and neutral and cannot exonerate. The chat log is IMPAIRED at weight 0.6 with issue code TRUNCATED_LOG - messages 002 and 003 implied by its own sequence numbering are missing - and I disclose that: the gap cuts both ways, and neither the surviving text nor the trip record's chat_message_count of 4 identifies any rider locating message inside the window.

POL-NS-05 cannot be run on this record. It requires matching the 'arrived' event to a GPS fix, and the record's own finding is that the 228 s clock skew makes any such matching unsafe under POL-NS-08(a), which must be applied before POL-NS-05 can operate. On the corrected clock the driver was inside the 150 m radius at the arrival marker, so neither limb of the false-arrival test - more than 300 m from the pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or above at that moment - is established. The trace is IMPAIRED at weight 0.25 with issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

Where the fee stands, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the $6.00 fee in force, which is $4.80, and the anti-farming check does not trip on either limb: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the 4-termination limb, and 2 divided by completed_trips_30d of 156 is a rate of 0.013, far under the 0.08 limb. Those are exactly the two fields POL-NS-07 names, read as it names them.

Even on the reading most hostile to the driver, the arrival and dwell facts rest solely on the GPS trace, and its impairment under POL-NS-08(a) (228 s clock skew) and POL-NS-08(b) (a 186 s gap inside the waiting window) takes the case at most to human review under POL-NS-09(e). Under POL-GEN-02(2) that single carrier caps confidence at 0.25, so it cannot alone support a ruling against the driver, and the disputed $6.00 is HELD rather than collected or refunded while review is pending. The driver's worst outcome on this record is a hold, not a refund to the rider.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties — here is what this ruling does and why.

OUTCOME. The $6.00 no-show charge is HELD: it is not collected from the rider and not refunded to him while a human reviewer decides the case. No driver compensation is paid at this stage. This is an escalation under POL-NS-09, which is terminal for the automated pipeline.

WHY THE FEE CANNOT BE DECIDED ON THIS RECORD. A no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold. The two in dispute are (b) that the trace placed the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the arrival event, and (c) that he then held position for the free waiting period in force, which for this AIRPORT pickup is 480 seconds (trip record platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 480). POL-NS-01(c) measures that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the arrival tap, so the dwell is the deciding fact. The only artifact that measures it is EV-GPS-00210, and it is impaired for policy purposes, not merely at schema level:
- POL-NS-08(a): the driver device clock runs 228 s ahead of the server, more than double that limb's 90 s threshold, so no fix can be safely matched to the arrival or termination event;
- POL-NS-08(b): a 186 s sampling gap straddles geofence entry, and only 5 fixes fall inside the waiting window against the 6 the limb requires.
Read at face value the trace puts the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 23:42:21 and the dwell at 404 s — 76 s short of 480 s. Corrected for the 228 s skew the same fix is 23:38:33 and the dwell is 632 s — comfortably over. The gap conceals the one fact that would choose between the two, and nothing else in the bundle supplies it. Because the only evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(b), POL-NS-09(e) applies and the case goes to human review. Two further triggers point the same way: the trip record and the trace contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell (POL-NS-09(b)), and POL-NS-05 cannot be run to recompute the waiting clock because the very skew that would have to be corrected makes the arrival-to-fix match unsafe; and confidence is capped at the trace's weight of 0.25 under POL-GEN-02(2), below the 0.70 floor, so POL-NS-09(a) applies as well.

ON YOUR CLAIMS.
Driver's points. Your limb (a)/(d) point is correct as far as it goes: the trip record carries an arrival event at 23:42:10 and a driver termination at 23:49:05 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, so limbs (a) and (d) are met. Your fare-integrity point is also correct: the $6.00 charged equals the $6.00 AIRPORT zone fee and reconciles with the fare line, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged on the amount (EV-FARE-00210, COMPLETE, weight 1.0). But your central point — that correcting the 228 s skew puts the driver in the geofence at 23:38:33 and yields a 632 s dwell — I cannot accept. POL-NS-08(a) treats that skew as disabling, and the policy does not let a party re-time a trace through it; the 186 s gap runs exactly across geofence entry, so whether the driver was inside at the arrival moment is unobserved rather than proved. Limbs (b) and (c) are therefore undecided, not satisfied. Your POL-NS-07 compensation claim ($4.80 = 80 percent of $6.00; anti-farming not tripped at 2 no_show_terminations_30d against 156 completed_trips_30d, a rate of 0.013) is arithmetically right on the two fields that clause names, but compensation issues only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not here.
Rider's points. Your point that the driver cannot be exonerated on the contact limb, and the driver's matching point, are accepted: the trace carries no rider_track (rider_presence.available is false), so POL-NS-04 limb (c) cannot be run, and under POL-NS-11 it is undecidable and neutral — neither satisfied nor failed — and POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on it. Your remaining point — that the trip record's own arithmetic (wait_time_min 6.9, about 414 s, roughly 66 s short of 480 s) proves the shortfall — I cannot accept either. That record is itself impaired (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, weight 0.4, on precisely its arrived_at and implied-wait fields), so under POL-NS-08 it cannot alone support a ruling against the party it disfavours; it and the trace disagree about the size of the shortfall, and that disagreement is unresolvable on this bundle. For completeness: EV-CHAT-00210 is impaired (TRUNCATED_LOG, weight 0.6; messages 002 and 003 implied by its own sequence and by chat_message_count of 4 are missing) and EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0), which makes POL-NS-06(i) accumulation unavailable — but neither carries the dwell, and the missing advisory exonerates no one.

The open question for the reviewer: on the platform's full-resolution record, did the driver's device hold position inside the 150 m Changi T1 arrival radius continuously for 480 s before the 23:49:05 cancellation — that is, is the true first in-geofence fix 23:42:21 (404 s, short) or 23:38:33 (632 s, sufficient)? The reviewer should obtain the full-resolution GPS stream and the missing chat messages 002-003.

REFERRALS. None. No clause of this policy directs one on these facts: POL-NS-05(ii) (false-arrival record) does not fire because qualifying in-geofence fixes exist and POL-NS-05 cannot be run through the skew, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip.

This ruling is provisional and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days. The $6.00 fee (fare_breakdown payment_status PENDING) stays on hold: not collected and not refunded meanwhile.
